title: 0.14.0: lore check reports an ADR status outside the profile enum, and lore supersede sets both ends
description: Operator-approved 0.14.0 item (opum-doc seq 179, ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-10, read verbatim on opum-agent OPAG-1094 at origin/dev 647473bd): (a) lore check reports an ADR whose status is outside the profile enum, and lore supersede sets both ends. Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md. Workers implement exactly this and report issues to opum-doc; they make no design calls. Filed 2026-10-03, not to be started until the 0.13.0 PR (opum-ai/lore-cli#476) is merged and the fleet restart is behind us.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore check enforces the ADR status enum (draft, stable, deprecated) on every OKF version: an out-of-enum status is an error on 0.1 AND on 0.2, and all three valid values pass on both.
lore supersede writes deprecated (not the invalid superseded) on a 0.1 bundle, setting both ends.
The CHANGELOG names the one-line fix for existing 0.1 ADRs that carry status: superseded.

implementationNotes:
INVESTIGATION (2026-10-14, branch feat/LCLI-669-adr-status-enum-and-supersede-ends). Design of record read BY REF: opum-doc docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md, section "Lore, built by lore-cli in 0.14.0".
(a) AC2 IS ALREADY DONE and tested: src/commands/supersede.ts wires superseded_by plus the lifecycle marker on the old concept and supersedes on the new one, and test/supersede.test.ts asserts status: deprecated (OKF 0.2) and status: superseded (legacy OKF 0.1). Nothing to implement.
(b) AC1 exists ONLY for OKF 0.2 bundles: src/core/schema.ts validateVersionedFrontmatter returns early unless profile.okfVersion === "0.2", and lore-cli's OWN bundle is OKF 0.1 (docs/index.md carries no okf_version), so an out-of-enum ADR status is silently accepted here. PROVED by probe: an ADR carrying status: superseded in this bundle produced a frontmatter warning for a missing summary and required-section errors, but NO finding for the status itself. No test anywhere asserts the lifecycle-status rejection.
(c) CONFLICT needing a ruling: lore supersede deliberately writes the LEGACY status: superseded on the old ADR in a 0.1 bundle, so a version-independent ADR status check would flag lore supersede's own output. The design of record says the old ADR goes to deprecated (a profile value), so either supersede should stop writing superseded in 0.1, or the check must be scoped. The task says workers make no design calls, so this is REPORTED, not settled.

DEC-192 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1004), relayed by the leader 2026-10-14, verbatim in substance: option A, task UNPARKED, ordinary under DEC-182. Both bundles' adr.schema.json define the status enum as [draft, stable, deprecated] (opum-doc read at 03:19Z), so "superseded" was never valid in 0.1 — this is a DEFECT FIX, not a behaviour change. supersede writes "deprecated" on 0.1, and check enforces the enum on every OKF version. Prove it both ways: out-of-enum is an error on 0.1 AND 0.2, and the three valid values pass on both. The CHANGELOG names the one-line fix for existing 0.1 ADRs. Branch feat/LCLI-669-adr-status-enum-and-supersede-ends; one branch, one PR; stop at the green head for a DEC-183 reviewer; do not merge.
